skill.summary: Greek tax compliance with AADE/TAXIS integration — VAT, payroll, EFKA, municipal taxes, stamp duty. Human confirmation for all submissions.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added explicit setup instructions for environment variables and compliance directories.
- Enforced human approval for all AADE/TAXIS submissions (four-eyes workflow; preparer and approver must be different).
- Clarified that AADE credentials are needed only when submitting filings (not for offline preparation).
- Updated metadata to declare required and optional environment variables, with usage notes.
- Improved security guidance: credentials are not stored, and all calculations can be done fully offline.
- Condensed and clarified skill description for easier understanding.
